'''2007 Pennsylvania State Championship Bill Kafer DS Endor Operations''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Bill Kafer]] at [[2007 Pennsylvania State Championship]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Endor Operations / Imperial Outpost|Endor-D-endoroperations.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' Gumbercules
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS13]]
